name: Office viewer
description: Shows the text of Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents (docx, xlsx, pptx), and their properties, sheets and slides as a tree.

codes.01a1b720-fdc2-7718-851e-092f28c86d2f.too: The document has more than 10,000 parts and is not read.
A part of the document unpacks to more than 64 MiB and is not read.
A part of the document unpacks to more than 500 times its packed size and is not read.
A part of the document nests its content too deeply to be read.
codes.01a1b720-fdc2-7718-851e-092f28c86d2f.dam: The document is damaged, encrypted or packed in a way the viewer cannot read.
codes.01a1b720-fdc2-7718-851e-092f28c86d2f.not: The file is a zip archive, but not a Word, Excel or PowerPoint document.
